name: com.vynqlo/vynqlo-mcp
title: Vynqlo AI Subscriptions & Global Gift Cards
description: ChatGPT, Claude & Cursor subscription top-ups + instant US/JP Apple, Steam & Google Play gift cards

tools.name: vynqlo_list_products
tools.description: Query Vynqlo live USD/CNY prices, stock, and instant checkout URLs across 34 brands and 251 SKUs in 9 languages (zh, zh-tw, en, ru, ja, ko, es, fr, pt): (1) Official password-free AI subscription top-ups (ChatGPT Go/Plus/Pro, Claude Pro/Max/Claude Code, Google Gemini AI Pro, Cursor, Midjourney, Perplexity, SuperGrok, GitHub Copilot); (2) Social & Streaming memberships (X Premium Blue-V, Telegram Premium @username direct top-up, YouTube Premium, Spotify, Netflix, Discord Nitro, LinkedIn Premium); (3) Instant-delivery Global Gift Cards (US & Japan Apple Gift Card, Google Play, Steam USD, PlayStation PSN, Xbox, Amazon US, Nintendo eShop, Roblox). Supports USDT (TRC20), Alipay, WeChat Pay & Reseller API.

brand.description: Optional brand filter (9-language aliases including Russian/CJK supported): chatgpt, claude, google, cursor, midjourney, perplexity, grok, copilot, x, telegram, youtube, spotify, netflix, discord, linkedin, apple, gplay, steam, psn, xbox, amazon, nintendo, roblox.

category.description: Optional category filter: "ai" (AI Subscriptions), "social" (Social & Streaming), or "gift" (Gift Cards).

lang.description: Language for returned storefront URLs: zh, zh-tw, en, ru, ja, ko, es, fr, pt.

tools.name: vynqlo_quote_order
tools.description: Calculate exact USD & CNY price, USDT TRC20 wallet cost, and localized direct checkout URL for any SKU (e.g. chatgpt.plus.1m, claude.pro.1m, cursor.pro.1m, apple.us.25, steam.usd.20).

sku.description: SKU code (e.g. chatgpt.plus.1m, claude.pro.1m, apple.us.25) or brand name.

quantity.description: Quantity (1–10 for gift card codes, 1 for subscriptions).

lang.description: zh, zh-tw, en, ru, ja, ko, es, fr, pt

tools.name: vynqlo_reseller_api_guide
tools.description: Retrieve HMAC-SHA256 authentication details and endpoint specs for programmatic gift card & AI subscription ordering via https://vynqlo.com/api/open/v1.

tools.name: vynqlo_service_status
tools.description: Check Vynqlo live storefront categories, payment methods (USDT TRC20, Alipay, WeChat Pay), and 9-language storefront URLs.

tools.name: vynqlo_create_order
tools.description: Create a live Vynqlo order in the user’s local language (zh, ru, en, zh-tw, ja, ko, es, fr, pt) across all 31 brands & 246 SKUs: instant-delivery Gift Cards (Russia RUB / Turkey TRY / US / JP Apple App Store, PSN Turkey/US, Steam USD, Google Play, Netflix, Razer Gold), scan-to-install QR Travel eSIMs (+1 US / +44 UK phone numbers & 120+ countries, Airalo vouchers), official Binance USDT Gift Cards (1–500 USDT) & direct TRON TRC20 wallet top-ups, Telegram Premium, and ChatGPT/Claude/Cursor official top-ups. Works with ZERO registration (returns Alipay/WeChat QR payment link & zero-fee USDT TRC20 option), OR pass app_id + app_secret for 100% automated API-balance fulfillment (including real US +1 SIM SMS numbers).

sku.description: Exact SKU code from vynqlo_list_products (e.g. apple.ru.1000, apple.us.25, esim.num.us_7d, sms.once.chatgpt, binance.usdt.20, usdtbuy.trc20.50, chatgpt.plus.1m).

quantity.description: Quantity (1–10 for code SKUs, 1 otherwise). Default 1.

channel.description: Preferred payment method: "usdt" (TRON TRC20 zero fee), "alipay", or "wechat".

lang.description: User’s local language: ru, zh, zh-tw, en, ja, ko, es, fr, pt.

email.description: Optional buyer email for order lookup.

wallet_address.description: Required only for usdtbuy.trc20.* SKUs (34-char TRON address starting with T).

account_email.description: Required only for AI/social official checkout link SKUs.

checkout_url.description: Required only for AI/social official checkout link SKUs (https://...).

app_id.description: Optional Vynqlo Open API App ID for instant automated balance deduction (required for sms.* agent orders).

app_secret.description: Optional Vynqlo Open API Secret matching app_id.

tools.name: vynqlo_create_usdt_exchange
tools.description: Create an instant TRON (TRC20) USDT buyback order (20–50,000 USDT) paid out in CNY to Alipay or WeChat (ideal for 1688, Poizon, Taobao, Chinese suppliers, or cashing out USDT). Returns a dedicated TRON deposit address, unique exact USDT amount, CNY payout total, and localized instructions in 9 languages.

usdt_amount.description: Amount of USDT (TRC20) to sell (20 to 50000).

payout_account.description: Recipient Alipay phone/email or WeChat ID.

payout_name.description: Recipient real name on Alipay/WeChat (used to verify recipient before transfer).

lang.description: User’s local language: ru, zh, zh-tw, en, ja, ko, es, fr, pt.

tools.name: vynqlo_check_order
tools.description: Check live payment & fulfillment status for any Vynqlo order (VQ... or RC...) in 9 languages. Once paid, immediately returns delivered Gift Card PIN codes, Binance 16-digit USDT codes, Travel eSIM QR URL & LPA activation code, or verifies a submitted TRON tx_hash for RC... USDT exchange orders.

order_no.description: Order number starting with VQ (storefront) or RC (USDT exchange).

tx_hash.description: Optional TRON transaction hash / Tronscan URL when verifying an RC... USDT exchange transfer.

lang.description: ru, zh, zh-tw, en, ja, ko, es, fr, pt.

app_id.description: Optional App ID if checking an API-owned order.

app_secret.description: Optional App Secret if checking an API-owned order.

tools.name: vynqlo_check_sms_inbox
tools.description: Poll live incoming SMS verification codes (for ChatGPT, Claude, Google, Apple ID, Telegram, WhatsApp, Discord) on a purchased real non-VoIP US carrier SIM order (sms.*). Automatically refunds 100% to Vynqlo balance if no SMS arrives within 20 minutes on one-time orders.

app_id.description: Vynqlo Open API App ID that owns the SMS order.

app_secret.description: Vynqlo Open API Secret matching app_id.

lang.description: ru, zh, zh-tw, en, ja, ko, es, fr, pt.
